SELECT n1.id, n1.root_id, n1.acl_all, n1.acl_spec, n1.frag, n1.f_created_at FROM (SELECT ? AS id, 1 AS ord) AS f0 LEFT JOIN anchors s1 ON s1.id = f0.id JOIN anchors e1 ON e1.kind = 'EdgeAnchor' AND ((e1.src = f0.id AND (e1.dst_type IS NULL OR (e1.dst_type = ? OR e1.dst_type IN (SELECT type_name FROM graph_types WHERE ancestor = ?)))) OR (e1.undirected AND (e1.dst = f0.id AND (e1.src_type IS NULL OR (e1.src_type = ? OR e1.src_type IN (SELECT type_name FROM graph_types WHERE ancestor = ?)))))) JOIN g_n_profile_d2a57d n1 ON n1.id = CASE WHEN e1.src = f0.id THEN e1.dst ELSE e1.src END ORDER BY f0.ord, e1.seq, e1.id
